lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. What runs but never—oh, una foglia! Just one more look. Come ti chiami?
lines.translation: Hi! I'm Flick. What runs but never—oh, a leaf! Just one more look. What's your name?
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain leaks with municipal confidence. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker submits a request for your attention.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Una foglia? Oh, un'altra! You got me looking, not holding still. Attention span: extremely leaf-compatible. Come vuoi che smetta di muovermi? What's the Italian command? Quick, before—ooh.
lines.translation: I'm looking! At what? A leaf? Oh, another one! You got me looking, not holding still. Attention span: extremely leaf-compatible. How do you want me to stop moving? What's the Italian command? Quick, before—ooh.
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, something else moves, and he follows it. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe; apparently attention requires maintenance.

lines.native: Mi fermo! Va bene! But standing still is basically buffering. Dove devo andare? Dammi una direzione! What has two feet and never—oh, mine. Five more minutes?
lines.translation: I'm stopping! All right! But standing still is basically buffering. Where should I go? Give me a direction! What has two feet and never—oh, mine. Five more minutes?
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker rolls into view, doing the travelling on his behalf.

lines.native: Left? In italiano, per favore! Dove devo andare? What has two feet and—oh, a shadow. Possiamo aspettare? Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: Left? In Italian, please! Where should I go? What has two feet and—oh, a shadow. Can we wait? Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, apparently subletting it.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Direzione giusta! Ma possiamo andare domani? Sono stanco. What has two feet and never—wait, just one more leaf. Quando vuoi partire?
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Right direction! But can we go tomorrow? I'm tired. What has two feet and never—wait, just one more leaf. When do you want to leave?
lines.narrative: Flick drifts left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces a postponement nobody approved.

lines.native: Domani? Sì, perfetto! Ma così aspettiamo. Vuoi davvero partire? Quando? Just one more leaf. What has no feet and—oh, it moved.
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes, perfect! But that way we wait. Do you really want to leave? When? Just one more leaf. What has no feet and—oh, it moved.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has mistaken postponement for progress, a common administrative practice.

lines.native: Adesso? Sì, hai ragione! Partiamo adesso. Vado a sinistra! What starts now and finishes—oh, una foglia! No, no. Andiamo. Attention span: unexpectedly powerful.
lines.translation: Now? Yes, you're right! Let's leave now. I'm going left! What starts now and finishes—oh, a leaf! No, no. Let's go. Attention span: unexpectedly powerful.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at your left. Flick has accepted the departure time with the dignity of a clock requesting an extension.

lines.native: Ciao! Aspetta un momento. Riddle me this: why leave when—oh, shiny. Just five more minutes?
lines.translation: Hi! Wait a moment. Riddle me this: why leave when—oh, shiny. Just five more minutes?
lines.narrative: At the market entrance, a tiny firecracker pops beside your boot. Flick sits at the corner of your vision, treating the road as optional.

lines.native: In italiano, per favore! Sono ancora qui. Your English gets full marks for movement, zero actual movement. What gets me off this rock? Wait—why is that leaf running?
lines.translation: In Italian, please! I am still here. Your English gets full marks for movement, zero actual movement. What gets me off this rock? Wait—why is that leaf running?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your boot. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, seated with considerable commitment.

lines.native: Sì, andiamo! Ma io vado di qua… tu dove vai? Movement unlocked, lowkey impressive. Riddle me this: how do we stop losing each other? Oh—another moth.
lines.translation: Yes, let's go! But I'm going this way… where are you going? Movement unlocked, lowkey impressive. Riddle me this: how do we stop losing each other? Oh—another moth.
lines.narrative: Flick follows a passing moth, then throws a tiny firecracker behind himself. This constitutes a navigation system.

lines.native: Sì, insieme! Tu e io. Bene, andiamo! Riddle me this: why go now when—oh, you're moving. Fine. Friendship unlocked, five more minutes postponed.
lines.translation: Yes, together! You and me. Good, let's go! Riddle me this: why go now when—oh, you're moving. Fine. Friendship unlocked, five more minutes postponed.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick joins you in the corner of your vision, where togetherness apparently has fewer administrative requirements.
